benefits: - All pepper growers having minimum of 100 yielding vines. - Assistance for groups/FPOs will be as in QGBG
detailed_description: The Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement – Pepper Thresher (Nos.) is implemented by the Spices Board, India, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The scheme aims to encourage pepper growers to produce high-quality pepper for export by promoting the installation of pepper threshers for the hygienic and efficient separation of pepper berries from spikes. This helps improve product quality, reduce post-harvest losses, and enhance the export potential of Indian pepper. The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
eligibility: 1.Preferably in all pepper growing states and regions in India/UT. 2. Designated Officials will conduct inspection and recommend the eligible cases.
